info: Maximum number of line-of-sight results kept in the skew-vision LRU cache.  Higher values reduce redundant ray traces at the cost of more RAM.  Reduce if memory is tight; increase on machines with spare RAM and many on-screen creatures.
name: SKEW_VISION_CACHE_SIZE

info: Enable worker-thread parallelism for expensive per-turn computations (monster planning, map-cache building, scent map updates, etc).  Disable to run everything on the main thread — useful for debugging, reproducibility testing, or machines where thread overhead exceeds gain.  Requires restart.
name: MULTITHREADING_ENABLED

info: Number of worker threads in the persistent thread pool.  0 means automatic (hardware concurrency minus 1, leaving one core for the main/SDL thread).  Set to a lower value to cap CPU usage, e.g. when streaming or running other CPU-heavy applications alongside the game.  Requires restart.
name: THREAD_POOL_WORKERS

info: Compute monster AI plans (pathfinding target selection, LOS queries) in parallel across worker threads each turn.  Disable if monsters behave unexpectedly or for reproducible save-file testing.  Requires restart.
name: PARALLEL_MONSTER_PLANNING

info: Number of monsters batched into a single worker-thread task during the parallel planning pass.  Smaller values improve load balancing when planning cost varies widely (large hordes with mixed sight ranges); larger values reduce task-dispatch overhead.  Requires restart.
name: MONSTER_PLAN_CHUNK_SIZE

info: Build per-z-level map caches (transparency, outside, floor, vehicle-obscured) in parallel across worker threads.  Disable on machines where the thread-dispatch overhead exceeds the benefit (typically dual-core systems or when z-levels are disabled).  Requires restart.
name: PARALLEL_MAP_CACHE

info: Compute the scent-diffusion Y-pass and X-pass across worker threads.  Disable on machines where the ~70 k-cell work unit is too small to amortize dispatch latency.  Requires restart.
name: PARALLEL_SCENT_UPDATE

info: Submap radius of the reality bubble (submaps visible beyond your position). Grid size = 2 × size + 3 submaps per side (size 4 → 11×11, legacy default). Maximum player sight range = 12 × (size + 1) tiles.  Larger values increase the loaded area and memory usage; smaller values reduce both.
name: REALITY_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Preload a one-overmap-tile border around the reality bubble over several turns.  This reduces map-shift hitches at the cost of extra per-turn loading work and    some additional memory usage.
name: LAZY_BORDER

info: Shrink the reality bubble to this radius while the player is performing a mobile activity (crafting, construction, etc.).  0 disables the feature.  Must be smaller than Reality Bubble Size to take effect.
name: ACTIVITY_MOBILE_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Shrink the reality bubble to this radius while the player is performing an idle activity (sleeping, reading, waiting, etc.).  0 disables the feature.  Must be smaller than Reality Bubble Size to take effect.
name: ACTIVITY_IDLE_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Shrink the reality bubble to this radius while the player is underground and indoors (no sky visible).  0 disables the feature.  Must be smaller than Reality Bubble Size to take effect.
name: UNDERGROUND_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Shrink the reality bubble to this radius while the player is actively driving a vehicle  or mounted on a creature. Useful with a high render distance to reduce lag at speed.  0 disables the feature.  Must be smaller than Reality Bubble Size to take effect.
name: VEHICLE_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Shrink the reality bubble to this radius while hostile creatures are visible nearby.  Uses the same detection range as safe mode.  0 disables the feature.  Must be smaller than Reality Bubble Size to take effect.
name: COMBAT_BUBBLE_SIZE

info: Minimum length of activity in minutes before the reality bubble shrinks.  Acts as a safety net to avoid unnecessary resizes for short tasks.  Default is 5 minutes.
name: ACTIVITY_BUBBLE_GRACE

info: Consecutive turns a condition must be met before the reality bubble shrinks for underground, vehicle, and combat modes.  Prevents rapid resizing when briefly entering or leaving a trigger zone.  Default is 5 turns.
name: DYNAMIC_BUBBLE_GRACE

info: Determines the movement rate of monsters.  A higher value increases monster speed and a lower reduces it.  Requires world reset.
name: MONSTER_SPEED

info: Determines how much damage monsters can take.  A higher value makes monsters more resilient and a lower makes them more flimsy.  Requires world reset.
name: MONSTER_RESILIENCE

info: ( WIP feature ) Determines terrain, shops, plants, and more.
name: DEFAULT_REGION

info: How many days into the year the cataclysm occurred.  Day 0 is Spring 1.  Day -1 randomizes the start date.  Can be overridden by scenarios.  This does not advance food rot or monster evolution.
name: INITIAL_DAY

info: How many days after the cataclysm the player spawns.  Day 0 is the day of the cataclysm.  Can be overridden by scenarios.  Increasing this will cause food rot and monster evolution to advance.
name: SPAWN_DELAY

info: Hour of the day at which the player starts the game.
name: INITIAL_TIME

info: Season length, in days.
name: SEASON_LENGTH

info: Hour of sunrise at the summer solstice for the base dimension.  Per-dimension overrides can be set in world_types JSON.
name: SUNRISE_SUMMER

info: Hour of sunrise at the winter solstice for the base dimension.
name: SUNRISE_WINTER

info: Hour of sunrise at the spring and autumn equinox for the base dimension.
name: SUNRISE_EQUINOX

info: Hour of sunset at the summer solstice for the base dimension.
name: SUNSET_SUMMER

info: Hour of sunset at the winter solstice for the base dimension.
name: SUNSET_WINTER

info: Hour of sunset at the spring and autumn equinox for the base dimension.
name: SUNSET_EQUINOX

info: Sets the time of construction in percents.  '50' is two times faster than default, '200' is two times longer.  '0' makes construction instant.
name: CONSTRUCTION_SCALING

info: Sets default crafting speed in percents.  '50' is two times faster than default, '200' is two times longer.  '0' makes crafting instant.
name: CRAFTING_SPEED_MULT

info: Sets the time of crop growth in percents.  '50' is two times faster than default, '200' is two times longer.  '0' automatically scales growth time to match the world's season length.
name: GROWTH_SCALING

info: Keep the initial season for ever.
name: ETERNAL_SEASON

info: Emulation of zombie hordes.  Zombie spawn points wander around cities and may go to noise.  Must reset world directory after changing for it to take effect.
name: WANDER_SPAWNS

info: If true, spawn zombies at shelters.  Makes the starting game a lot harder.
name: BLACK_ROAD

info: If true, static NPCs will spawn at pre-defined locations.  Requires world reset.
name: STATIC_NPC

info: Determines whether starting NPCs should spawn, and if they do, how exactly.
default: Default: scenario - Values: never, always, scenario
name: STARTING_NPC

info: If true, the game will randomly spawn NPCs during gameplay.
name: RANDOM_NPC

info: If true, radiation causes the player to mutate.
name: RAD_MUTATION

info: How to handle the last visited pocket dimension. 'Off' unloads normally. 'None' keeps loaded but frozen for fast travel. 'Minimal' simulates fields only (fire, gas). 'Moderate' adds vehicle systems (solar charging). 'Full' simulates everything including off-screen combat.
default: Default: off - Values: off, none, minimal, moderate, full
name: POCKET_SIMULATION_LEVEL

info: Allowed point pools for character generation.
default: Default: any - Values: any, multi_pool, no_freeform
name: CHARACTER_POINT_POOLS

info: When enabled, character ages are constrained by profession-defined age ranges when available.
name: ENFORCE_PROFESSION_AGE_RANGE

info: If true, will show additional warnings for JSON data correctness.
name: STRICT_JSON_CHECKS

info: If false, the game will keep tileset in memory after first load to speed up subsequent loadings of game data.  Enable this if you're working on a tileset for the game or a mod.
name: FORCE_TILESET_RELOAD

info: Displays what content pack a piece of furniture, terrain, item or monster comes from or is affected by.  Disable if it's annoying.
name: MOD_SOURCE

info: Displays internal IDs of game objects and creatures.  Warning: IDs may contain spoilers.
name: SHOW_IDS

info: Debug information
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_DEBUG

info: General information
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_INFO

info: Warnings
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_WARNING

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_GAME

info: Generic messages related to game startup and operation.
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAIN

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAP

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAPGEN

info: Messages related to tile memory (map_memory.cpp).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAPMEM

info: Messages related to NPCs (npcs*.cpp).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_NPC

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_SDL

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_LUA

info: Determines the scope, which is known in the beginning of the game.
name: DISTANCE_INITIAL_VISIBILITY

info: Initial points available to spend on stats on character generation.
name: INITIAL_STAT_POINTS

info: Initial points available to spend on traits on character generation.
name: INITIAL_TRAIT_POINTS

info: Initial points available to spend on skills on character generation.
name: INITIAL_SKILL_POINTS

info: Maximum trait points available for character generation.
name: MAX_TRAIT_POINTS

info: Scales experience gained from practicing skills and reading books.  0.5 is half as fast as default, 2.0 is twice as fast, 0.0 disables skill training except for NPC training.
name: SKILL_TRAINING_SPEED

info: Set the level of skill rust.  Vanilla: Vanilla Cataclysm - Capped: Capped at skill levels 2 - Int: Intelligence dependent - IntCap: Intelligence dependent, capped - Off: None at all.
default: Default: off - Values: vanilla, capped, int, intcap, off
name: SKILL_RUST

info: Maximum distance at which items are considered available for crafting (or some other actions).
name: PICKUP_RANGE

info: If false, achievements and some Magiclysm functionality won't work, but performance will be better.
name: ENABLE_EVENTS

info: If true, enables somewhat unfinished electric grid system that may slow the game down.
name: ELECTRIC_GRID

info: Explosive items and traps will detonate when hit by damage exceeding the threshold.  A higher number means more damage is required to detonate.  Set to 0 to disable.
name: MADE_OF_EXPLODIUM

info: If true, items flung by explosions will deal (lethal) damage to whatever they hit.
name: ITEM_DAMAGE_ON_FLYING_IMPACT

info: If true, disables new raycasting based explosive system in favor of old system.  With new system obstacles (impassable terrain, furniture or vehicle parts) will block shrapnel, while blast will bash obstacles and throw creatures outward.  If obstacles are destroyed, blast continues outward.
name: OLD_EXPLOSIONS

info: If true, injuries cause persistent pain until they are healed.
name: CHRONIC_PAIN

info: If true, bayonets replace weapon attack instead of adding to it.  WIP feature, weakens bayonets heavily at the moment.
name: LIMITED_BAYONETS

info: If true, opt out of new pathfinding in favor of legacy one. This makes pathfinding mods not work.
name: USE_LEGACY_PATHFINDING

info: Hard cap on straight-line pathfinding distance (in tiles) for the legacy pathfinder.  Monsters and NPCs whose configured range exceeds this value are limited to it.  The old fixed map allowed at most 120 tiles end-to-end; the default of 96 is 50%% larger than the old per-side maximum of 60.  Raise this if mods require longer paths; lower it to reduce pathfinding cost at large bubble sizes.
name: PATHFINDING_MAX_DIST
